workspace.name: EVD-0009 暫定Active Skill 80件カタログ

project_context.purpose: SKL-0001のHuman承認済み暫定Skill Balance Frameworkに基づいて設計したActive Skill候補80件を、後続のFormal Skill生成・装備可能Character選別・実戦Balance検証で再利用可能なEvidenceとして固定保存する。
project_context.summary: Physical/Multi-hit/Magic/DOT/Buff/Debuff/Heal/Barrier/Critical/Attribute/Special Support/Range/Status Template/PIERCE Templateを含む80件。数値は暫定Balance Candidateであり、Formal Skill Master登録済み・Balance Freeze済み・実戦検証済みを意味しない。

current_focus.theme: EVD-0009 暫定Active Skill 80件カタログ
current_focus.goal: 80件の仮SkillをEvidence Authorityとして登録し、後続工程でCurrent Formal Skillへ変換・検証できる入力データとして保持する。

source_baseline.source_role: Human-provided Fresh Current used to confirm Current Formal Skill source baseline

history.message: Created EVD-0009 as a new standalone Balance Evidence project containing 80 provisional Active Skill candidate records. No Skill Master registration, Source modification, Game Data modification, Simulation, or Battle execution was performed.

authority_basis.catalog_purpose: Create most of the provisional Active Skill test set up front from current SKL-0001, before character selection or battle matrix design.
authority_basis.evidence_boundary: This Evidence fixes the provisional candidate catalog only. It does not claim that all 80 entries already map 1:1 to Current Formal Skill fields, pass Formal validation, are obtainable by real Characters, or are Balance-correct in runtime combat.
authority_basis.human_review: Human instructed creation of a new Evidence registration dataset containing the full 80-skill provisional catalog.
